meta.methodology: Read framework.md for conceptual framework, torah_156_ce_edges.json for 7 cause/effect edges (containing 13 unique node IDs), torah_156_packages.json for 2 existing bechina-based packages (5 unique nodes including additions), and torah_156.txt for the full source text. Collected all nodes already assigned to packages (ASSIGNED_NODES = 5). Found 12 unique cause/effect node IDs not in ASSIGNED_NODES. Each unassigned node was assigned to the existing package whose essential nature best matches the node's own nature, with polarity considered. Where no existing package captures the node's essential nature, a new package was created.

assignments.reason: Purity of heart is the essential precondition and vessel from which Ruach HaKodesh flows. The Torah's key verse — 'לֵב טָהוֹר בְּרָא לִי אֱלֹקִים, אֲזַי וְרוּחַ נָכוֹן חַדֵּשׁ בְּקִרְבִּי' — presents the pure heart and the renewed spirit as two halves of a single verse, the same domain of holiness. The essential nature of טהרת הלב is the state of the heart receptive to divine speech, placing it squarely within the domain of holy spirit and authentic speech.

The verbal form of heart-purification (נטהר הלב) shares the same essential nature as טהרת הלב — the state of purity that enables divine speech. It is the achieved condition described in the Torah's central verse: once the heart is purified, one merits Ruach HaKodesh. Same domain as Package 1.

assignments.package_label: חֲמִימוּת וְהִתְלַהֲבוּת — Holy Warmth and Fervor
assignments.reason: The burning fervor of the heart toward God is the Torah's central mechanism — the holy fire that purifies the heart and expels the spirit of impurity. Its essential nature is FIRE/WARMTH directed toward God, a distinct conceptual domain from the speech/spirit of Package 1. The Torah draws an extended analogy between this spiritual fire and physical fire (כָּל דָּבָר אֲשֶׁר יָבֹא בָאֵשׁ תַּעֲבִירוּ בָאֵשׁ), establishing warmth/fervor as a coherent thematic domain. Assigned to new Package 3.

assignments.package_label: חֲמִימוּת וְהִתְלַהֲבוּת — Holy Warmth and Fervor
assignments.reason: Movement (of thought) is described in this Torah exclusively as the generator of holy warmth — 'תְּנוּעָה מְעוֹרֵר חֲמִימוּת.' The Torah elaborates that the essential movement is intellectual: thought moving from one holy idea to the next generates the burning heart. In the context of Torah #156, תנועה is entirely oriented toward the good domain — movement of thought contemplating God's greatness and Torah — and its essential nature is inseparable from the warmth it produces. While movement in the abstract could be neutral, in this Torah it functions within the holy warmth domain. Assigned to Package 3.

assignments.package_label: חֲמִימוּת וְהִתְלַהֲבוּת — Holy Warmth and Fervor
assignments.reason: One who justifies/draws the many toward God's service. In this Torah, מצדיק הרבים functions specifically as a SOURCE of holy warmth — compared to stars that receive warmth from the spheres above and transmit it below (Daniel 12:3: 'וּמַצְדִּיקֵי הָרַבִּים כַּכּוֹכָבִים'). The Torah uses this concept exclusively to explain how warmth is transmitted between people, making its essential role in this teaching inseparable from the warmth/fervor domain. The star-analogy establishes מצדיק הרבים as the social dimension of the חמימות mechanism. Assigned to Package 3.

assignments.package_label: חֲמִימוּת וְהִתְלַהֲבוּת — Holy Warmth and Fervor
assignments.reason: Driving away the spirit of impurity is the direct ACTION of the holy fire. The Torah states: 'הָאֵשׁ מְגָרֵשׁ הָאֲוִיר, עַל כֵּן הַחֲמִימוּת שֶׁבַּלֵּב... מְגָרֵשׁ אֶת רוּחַ הַטֻּמְאָה.' The expulsion is the essential function of warmth applied against evil. Its nature is a good act — a purifying operation — that belongs to the warmth/fire domain (fire drives away air/spirits). Not placed in Package 2 (evil) because the node describes the ACT of expulsion (a good operation), not the evil spirit itself.

new_packages.label: חֲמִימוּת וְהִתְלַהֲבוּת
new_packages.reason: Torah #156's cause/effect chain reveals a large, coherent conceptual domain centered on holy warmth/fervor (חמימות/התלהבות) that has no home in the two existing bechina-based packages. Package 1 (רוח הקדש והדבור) captures the GOAL — holy speech and divine spirit. Package 2 (רוח טומאה ושטות) captures the OBSTACLE — the evil spirit. But the Torah's entire middle section — the MECHANISM by which one moves from the obstacle to the goal — is dominated by the concept of holy fire: movement generates warmth, warmth burns in the heart toward God, that fire expels the spirit of impurity, and the result is a purified heart. This fire/warmth domain has a distinct essential nature: it is the element of אש (fire) operating in the spiritual realm. The Torah explicitly grounds it in physical fire-theory ('טֶבַע הָאֵשׁ שֶׁמְּגָרֵשׁ הָאֲוִיר') and extends it through the star/sphere cosmology ('מַצְדִּיקֵי הָרַבִּים כַּכּוֹכָבִים'). The 9 nodes assigned here all share this essential nature of holy fire/warmth/fervor as the active purifying force.

stats.structural_note: Torah #156's argument now maps to three packages: Package 3 (warmth/fervor — the mechanism) CAUSES Package 1 (Ruach HaKodesh — the goal) by OPPOSING Package 2 (spirit of impurity — the obstacle). The Torah's causal chain flows: [Pkg 3] תנועה → חמימות → מגרש רוח הטמאה [Pkg 2] → טהרת הלב → רוח הקדש [Pkg 1]. Package 3 also contains the social dimension: מצדיק הרבים → חמימות (transmitting warmth to others like stars transmitting from the spheres above).
